feature: shared print footer and DRAFT mark (rule 7), all 43 forms, never per form

design.footer: small text in the bottom margin of every printed page, outside the official drawing: form number, dashed TIN, the return period as the form states it (transaction date on one-time forms), filing state when there is one, and Page i of n counting every page including the receipt page
design.mark: diagonal, centered across the page, rotated -32 degrees, rgba(20,20,20,0.09), 40pt 'DRAFT – not filed'; the top margin is about 10pt, too thin for a margin banner, and the diagonal is the standard unfiled watermark
design.truth: footer state comes from the stored return's own lifecycle fields (status, submitted_at, submitted_dry_run, submission_filename). On the form-page print path the page-held draft is client input and drop_client_dry_run strips the dry-run facts from it, so screen_form_print/print_sample/preview_sync read those facts from the stored row the draft's own id names (furniture_truth). print_fields reads the stored draft directly. A return with no lifecycle facts is unfiled and wears the mark.
